what: FYI, done by db as a whole port for the OnceLock/LazyLock ban (unbuilt, RA clean): the borrow checker mode is no longer a process static. base_db::FrontSettings (a singleton input set from the process variables when a Db is made) holds BLAZE_BORROWCK, BLAZE_BORROWCK_DEBUG, BLAZE_TRACE_HOLDERS and RA_CHECK_RELATIVE_BODIES. hir_ty_borrowck::mode now takes db, and Mode is base_db::BorrowckMode re-exported (same variants). Callers updated: blaze-diagnostics cache.rs Inputs::of(db, lint_flags, options); its two callers in blaze-cargo serve/unit/deps.rs (db = lowered.db() was in scope); blaze-item-hash identity/inputs.rs crate_inputs (mode(db)).
